portal_description:
dbus-glib is an add-on library to integrate the standard D-Bus library with 
the GLib main loop and threading model.

dbus-glib has been updated to the upstream version 0.73.8, providing the 
following bug fix:

* cleanup of the DBusGProxy objects treated pending remote method calls 
incorrectly and may have resulted in freeing invalid memory. Consequently, 
processes using DBusGProxy objects may have crashed when the DBusGProxy 
object was freed. With this update dbus-glib correctly handles the 
destruction of DBusGProxy objects, resolving this issue.

This updated package also provides the following enhancements: 

* two new function calls, "dbus_g_proxy_call_with_timeout" and 
"dbus_g_proxy_begin_call_with_timeout", have been added to dbus-glib 
providing the ability to specify a timeout when making a request to a 
remote service.

* dbus-binding-tool now ignores namespaced Extensible Markup Language (XML) 
nodes when processing introspection definition files.

All dbus-glib users and users of programs that depend on dbus-glib are 
advised to upgrade to this updated package, which addresses this issue, and 
adds these enhancements.
